anita (eng-ml): Kicking off a small canary for horus-ptq (int4 PTQ) on /funcall today, 5 qps. Low risk, just want to watch structured-output compliance and parsing telemetry.
model-canary-bot: canary horus-ptq started on route /funcall, variant=ptq-int4, 5qps, start_ts=3519876543
mike (serving): Quick heads-up — I'm seeing parse_fail_rate jump from ~0.2% to ~3% on the horus-ptq canary. Only for tool-calls (json funcall). Pasting one representative response we captured:```Assistant: {"tool_call": {"name": "search", "args": {"q": "find hotels in SF", "limit": 5}}```
(note: missing closing brace in assistant block, then some free-text appended)
anita (eng-ml): ugh — that example looks like the model emitted a truncated JSON then kept generating. Any pattern on when this happens? long prompts / cached prefixes?
mike (serving): Pattern: high when kv_cache_hit=true and when seq_len_before_call > 600. If I disable kvcache locally for the same prompt mix failure drops to 0.3%. Suspect resume/stream boundary/tokenization interaction under PTQ kernels.
julia (devex): We can add a lightweight rescue in the parse stage: try NDJSON split then take last well-formed JSON, fallback to regex that grabs last brace-pair, and emit a structured parse_error telemetry tag. Example quick regex we used in other projects: ```/\{(?:[^{}]|(?R))*\}\s*$/``` — crude but catches a trailing JSON object.
mike (serving): Tried a simpler heuristic earlier: find first `{` before the last `}` and parse that slice. It recovers ~70% of these. Still leaves some semantic misalignments (wrong tool args).
leo (sre): Rolling back dedicated route to float16 variant for customer traffic to stop user-facing errors. Canary remains paused on prod.
anita (eng-ml): Proposed plan: 1) add parse-tail-rescue heuristic in devex parser behind feature flag (non-destructive) 2) run bucketed experiments sampling by seq_len and kv_cache_hit to reproduce and quantify 3) coordinate with runtime team to instrument token-level boundary traces for PTQ kernels and test a padding/resume fix. I'll open tracker.
julia (devex): I'll draft the rescue PR and include unit tests: examples for truncated-close, extra-suffix-text, and nested objects. Also adding telemetry dims: model_variant, kv_cache_hit, seq_len_bucket, raw_suffix_len.
mike (serving): Also worth trying a tiny change in generation config for PTQ canary: set `eos_penalty` and `stream_chunk_size=1` to force safer boundaries while we debug. Local probe with kvcache disabled: parse_fail_rate -> 0.28% (from model-canary-bot sampling).
model-canary-bot: canary metrics update: parse_fail_rate=3.12% (before), parse_fail_rate=0.29% (kvcache disabled probe), sample_n=1200, note=spike concentrated >600 seq len.
anita (eng-ml): TL;DR — unblocked customer traffic, feature-flagged parser rescue, telemetry plan, runtime follow-up. I'll post the tracker link when I open the ticket. :thumbsup:
julia (devex): Ping me when tracker exists and I'll attach PR draft + unit tests.
leo (sre): Thanks all. Keep SLO folks in the loop in case rollback windows expand.
